invariants: In-flight and ready cold sources are shared; the default ready LRU capacity is five, pins/reservations are not evicted as ordinary ready entries.
Observers can cancel without cancelling shared loads or committed work. Commit failures remove entries and wake waiters; invalidated work never resurrects an entry.
One exact unpublished Session reserves an identity. Reusable release preserves it; setup mutation discards it; live attachment consumes the exact reservation.
Public nonempty append and create reject reserved identities, snapshot append JSON before waiting and invalidate cached reads after successful writes; load waits for held reservations.
Cold revision changes cause reload/retry before reserve; repair is durably committed then reread. Unload invalidates entries, wakes waiters and drains active preparation work before backend close.
identity: SessionPreparations reserves exact source.session, not a same-ID replacement. Persisted cold inspection is detached from mutable setup state. Session end-seed counts toward the reuse boundary.
ownership: PreparedPersistence owns the per-backend pool; LivePersistence consumes exact publication reservations and drains it during owned teardown. A lease releases its pin once.
ordering: Shared source -> revision check -> serialized repair commit -> reread changed revision -> reserve -> unpublished setup -> exact live attach -> seed/suffix persistence. Storage locks serialize public writes with repair; empty appends remain no-ops.
errors: Preserve exact exception abort reasons; Python wraps non-exception reasons with a .reason field. Reserved writes reject; failed commits discard entries and wake waiters. Invalid or lossy append JSON rejects before disk writes.
cancellation: Signal cancellation is observer-local; started durable commit settles before checking cancellation. Python Task cancellation shields shared work and releases late reservations. A queued commit checks its abort after acquiring the storage lock, before repair.
adaptation: Python 3.8 futures, OrderedDict and locks replace Promises/Map. JSONL uses content hashes and SQLite detached metadata/event hashes for revision checks. Detached inspection copies substitute immutable reference views. Five real JSONL paired observations compare exact identity outcomes, event types, rejection/cancellation and physical lengths; they do not assert full storage-schema or cross-process parity.
